t: Nix Flake Python Solution: Venv, Cuda, macOS/Windows, Etc.
s: Darwinix provides a reproducible, cross-platform Python development environment using Nix Flakes, seamlessly integrating traditional pip installs, virtual environments, and optional CUDA support for data science workflows on macOS and Windows.
sub: Reproducible Python environments with Nix Flakes
Cross-platform development for macOS and Windows
Seamless integration of pip install and virtual environments
Optional CUDA GPU acceleration for data science
